definition: a room with a bath or shower, and often a toilet
exampleSentence: The bathroom is next to my bedroom.
exampleTranslation: Phòng tắm ở cạnh phòng ngủ của tôi.

definition: a large container that you fill with water to sit in and wash
exampleSentence: The bathtub is full of warm water.
exampleTranslation: Bồn tắm đầy nước ấm.

definition: an act of washing your body while sitting in a bath of water
exampleSentence: After a week of camping, I really needed a bath.
exampleTranslation: Sau một tuần cắm trại, tôi thật sự cần tắm bồn.

definition: equipment you stand under to wash your body, or the act of using it
exampleSentence: I take a shower every morning.
exampleTranslation: Tôi tắm vòi sen mỗi sáng.

definition: a curtain that keeps the water inside the shower
translation: rèm phòng tắm, màn che vòi sen
exampleSentence: Please close the shower curtain.
exampleTranslation: Bạn nhớ kéo rèm phòng tắm lại nhé.

definition: a piece of thick cloth on the floor next to the bath
translation: thảm chân phòng tắm, thảm lau chân
exampleSentence: Step on the bath mat when you get out.
exampleTranslation: Hãy bước lên thảm lau chân khi bạn bước ra.

definition: a large bowl you sit on to get rid of body waste, or the room with it
exampleSentence: Where is the toilet, please?
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn cho hỏi nhà vệ sinh ở đâu?

definition: to make water go through a toilet to clean it
translation: xả nước bồn cầu, giật nước
exampleSentence: Please flush the toilet after you use it.
exampleTranslation: Vui lòng xả nước bồn cầu sau khi dùng.

definition: soft thin paper for cleaning yourself after using the toilet
exampleSentence: We have no more toilet paper.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta hết giấy vệ sinh rồi.

definition: a piece of wet material that you use to clean something and then throw away
exampleSentence: I always carry wet wipes in my bag.
exampleTranslation: Tôi luôn mang khăn ướt trong túi.

definition: a piece of soft material worn in underwear to take in blood during a period
exampleSentence: I always carry sanitary pads in my bag.
exampleTranslation: Tôi luôn mang băng vệ sinh trong túi.

definition: a round container fixed to the bathroom wall, where you wash your hands and face
translation: bồn rửa mặt, chậu rửa mặt
exampleSentence: I washed my face in the basin.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rửa mặt ở bồn rửa.

definition: the thing you turn on and off to control water from a pipe
exampleSentence: The faucet in the bathroom is leaking.
exampleTranslation: Vòi nước trong phòng tắm bị rỉ nước.

definition: the hole in the bottom of a bath or sink that water flows out through
translation: lỗ thoát nước, cống thoát nước
exampleSentence: The drain in the shower is blocked.
exampleTranslation: Lỗ thoát nước trong phòng tắm bị tắc.

definition: to clean your body with soap and water
exampleSentence: Wash your hands with soap and water.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rửa tay bằng xà phòng và nước.

definition: to remove soap or dirt by washing quickly with water
exampleSentence: Rinse your hair well with warm water.
exampleTranslation: Hãy xả tóc thật sạch bằng nước ấm.

definition: a substance you use with water to wash your body
exampleSentence: Wash your hands with soap and water.
exampleTranslation: Rửa tay bằng xà phòng và nước.

definition: a liquid soap you use to wash yourself in the shower
exampleSentence: This shower gel smells like lemon.
exampleTranslation: Sữa tắm này có mùi chanh.

definition: a liquid soap that makes bubbles in your bath water
translation: sữa tắm tạo bọt, bọt tắm
exampleSentence: I put some bubble bath in the water.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho một ít sữa tắm tạo bọt vào nước.

definition: a small piece of cloth that you use to wash your face and body
exampleSentence: Wet the flannel with warm water.
exampleTranslation: Hãy làm ướt khăn mặt bằng nước ấm.

definition: a small square cloth for washing your hands and face
exampleSentence: I washed my face with a clean washcloth.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rửa mặt bằng một chiếc khăn mặt sạch.

definition: a large towel for drying your body after a bath or shower
exampleSentence: I need a dry bath towel.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần một chiếc khăn tắm khô.

definition: a loose piece of clothing that you wear before or after a bath or shower
exampleSentence: I put on my bathrobe after the shower.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc áo choàng tắm sau khi tắm xong.

definition: light soft shoes that you wear at home
exampleSentence: Take off your shoes and put on slippers.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cởi giày và mang dép đi trong nhà.

definition: a liquid soap for washing your hair
exampleSentence: What kind of shampoo do you use?
exampleTranslation: Bạn dùng loại dầu gội nào?

definition: a liquid you put on your hair after washing it to make it softer
exampleSentence: Use conditioner after you wash your hair.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng dầu xả sau khi gội đầu.

definition: a flat piece of plastic with thin teeth, used for making your hair tidy
exampleSentence: I need a comb for my hair.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần một cái lược để chải tóc.

definition: a brush that you use on your hair to make it smooth
translation: lược chải tóc, bàn chải tóc
exampleSentence: Please pass me my hairbrush.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn đưa tôi cái lược chải tóc.

definition: a machine that blows out hot air for drying hair
exampleSentence: I dry my hair with a hairdryer.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sấy tóc bằng máy sấy tóc.

definition: a thick substance that you put on your hair to keep it in style
translation: gel vuốt tóc, keo vuốt tóc
exampleSentence: Use a little hair gel.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng một chút gel vuốt tóc.

definition: a sticky liquid that you spray on your hair to keep it in place
exampleSentence: I use hairspray on special days.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng keo xịt tóc vào những ngày đặc biệt.

definition: a small brush that you use for cleaning your teeth
exampleSentence: Do not forget your toothbrush.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên bàn chải đánh răng của bạn.

definition: a thick substance that you use to clean your teeth
exampleSentence: We need to buy some toothpaste.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta cần mua kem đánh răng.

definition: thin strong string for cleaning between your teeth
exampleSentence: Use dental floss every day.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dùng chỉ nha khoa mỗi ngày.

definition: a liquid that makes your mouth smell fresh
exampleSentence: I use mouthwash after brushing.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng nước súc miệng sau khi đánh răng.

definition: to clean your teeth with a toothbrush
exampleSentence: Do not forget to brush your teeth.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên đánh răng nhé.

definition: to cut hair off your skin with a razor
exampleSentence: I shave every morning.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cạo râu mỗi sáng.

definition: a tool with a sharp blade for removing hair from your skin
exampleSentence: I need a new razor.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần một cái dao cạo mới.

definition: a small flat blade with a very sharp edge, used in a razor
exampleSentence: Be careful with the razor blade.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cẩn thận với lưỡi dao cạo.

definition: a small electric tool for shaving
exampleSentence: I bought an electric shaver.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một chiếc máy cạo râu điện.

definition: a cream that you put on your face when you shave
exampleSentence: Put shaving cream on your face first.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thoa kem cạo râu lên mặt trước.

definition: a substance you put under your arms to stop bad smells
translation: lăn khử mùi, chất khử mùi
exampleSentence: I put on deodorant every morning.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng lăn khử mùi mỗi sáng.

definition: a liquid with a strong pleasant smell that you put on your skin
exampleSentence: This perfume smells like flowers.
exampleTranslation: Nước hoa này có mùi hoa.

definition: a liquid that you put on your skin to clean, soften or protect it
exampleSentence: I put lotion on my hands.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thoa sữa dưỡng lên tay.

definition: a thick smooth substance that you put on your skin to make it soft
translation: kem dưỡng da, kem bôi da
exampleSentence: Put some cream on your dry hands.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thoa chút kem lên đôi tay khô của bạn.

definition: a cream that you put on your skin to make it less dry
exampleSentence: I use moisturizer after I wash my face.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng kem dưỡng ẩm sau khi rửa mặt.

definition: a cream that you put on your skin to stop the sun burning it
exampleSentence: Do not forget to put on sunscreen.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên thoa kem chống nắng.

definition: coloured substances that you put on your face to improve how it looks
exampleSentence: I do not wear much make-up.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không trang điểm nhiều.

definition: a small stick of colour that you put on your lips
exampleSentence: I bought a red lipstick.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một thỏi son đỏ.

definition: a dark substance that you use to colour your eyelashes
exampleSentence: I put mascara on my eyelashes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chuốt mascara lên lông mi.

definition: a coloured liquid that you paint on your nails
exampleSentence: I like your red nail polish.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích màu sơn móng tay đỏ của bạn.

definition: a special tool for cutting your nails
exampleSentence: Can I borrow your nail clippers?
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi mượn cái bấm móng tay của bạn được không?

definition: a thin piece of metal with a rough surface for shaping your nails
exampleSentence: I use a nail file to shape my nails.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng dũa móng tay để tạo dáng móng.

definition: a small tool with two narrow pieces of metal, used to pull out small things
exampleSentence: I use tweezers to pull out small hairs.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng nhíp để nhổ những sợi lông nhỏ.

definition: a soft mass of cotton used for cleaning the skin or small cuts
exampleSentence: Clean the cut with some cotton wool.
exampleTranslation: Hãy lau vết cắt bằng một ít bông gòn.

definition: a small stick with cotton wool at each end, used for cleaning your ears
exampleSentence: I bought a box of cotton buds.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua một hộp tăm bông.

definition: a container that very young children use as a toilet
exampleSentence: The baby is learning to use the potty.
exampleTranslation: Em bé đang tập dùng bô.

definition: a piece of soft cloth or paper that a baby wears to hold waste
exampleSentence: I need to change the baby's nappy.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần thay tã cho em bé.

definition: a piece of soft cloth or paper that a baby wears to hold waste
exampleSentence: I changed the baby's diaper.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã thay tã cho em bé.
